The Paracas Candelabra is often associated with the Nazca Lines. After the boat excursion, the route continues to the airfield, where you board a small plane for a flight over the Nazca Desert.

From the air, you can see huge depictions of a person and animals, including a monkey, hummingbird and spider, as well as geometric figures. The flight lasts 35 minutes. Afterwards, return to the airfield, travel to Lima and transfer to your hotel.

During the visit, you will learn about Amazonian traditions, daily life and history, including the period of the rubber boom.

Guests will see how cassava flour is prepared and how harvested rubber latex is smoked.

The visit lasts approximately 1 hour.

At the farm, you will also discover the history and cultural importance of cocoa.

During the excursion, you will see how cocoa is harvested, dried and ground before further processing. A separate part of the programme explores cocoa's origins and its traditional uses.

The programme also includes an introduction to a traditional cocoa drink and a tasting of organic chocolate. Transfer from the hotel is scheduled for 9:00.
